pending.chat: Requires the conversation model and the MCP server conversational agent. This screen was built on data the platform does not produce yet, and a chat form with no agent behind it would be an empty box.
pending.domains: Requires the domain model with ownership verification over DNS TXT or an HTTP file. Without that verification nothing can be scanned from the outside, so the table will be built together with the endpoint, not before it.
pending.assetDiscovery: Requires the discovery model and its daily quota. Discovery builds on verified domains, so it cannot exist before them.
pending.supplyChain: Requires the analysis engine to expose the dependency SBOM. It does not publish it today, so there is nothing to show even when the plan covers it.
pending.containers: Requires the container inventory and access to the host runtime, which is not implemented yet.
pending.networks: Requires the network scanner and the subdomain model. Both arrive with Phase 6.
pending.integrations: Requires connection storage and the OAuth flows for Jira and Linear. The outgoing webhook engine already works, and it is what those integrations will be built on.
pending.settings: The view is now built on operations that exist: soft-deletion of the workspace, issuing and revoking API tokens, and outgoing webhook configuration. Renaming the organization and billing still to come, each in its own block.
